source_evidence: Hedge funds typically limit opportunities to redeem, or cash in, your shares to four times a year or fewer. They also often impose a lock-up period of one year or more, during which you cannot cash in your shares.
question: Misconception: I can redeem my hedge fund shares whenever I want, as long as I give notice.
answer: Redemptions may be restricted. Hedge funds typically allow redemption only four times a year or fewer, and often have a lock-up period of one year or more when you cannot cash in your shares.
